name: audivo-local
description: Podcast transcripts in one call through the local Audivo MCP server, including YouTube episodes downloaded on your machine with yt-dlp and audio files on your disk. Asks for your Audivo API key once.

api_key.title: Audivo API key
api_key.description: An API key (hk_live_...) from https://dash.audivo.dev. Stored in your system's secure credential store.
